statements.text: Every persisting system must show mind-like qualities, a basic intelligence, to resist the second law, so IWMT and FEP-AI can be read as panprotopsychist. IWMT is not panpsychist: experience arises only in systems that have models, not merely are models, and only when those models generate worlds coherent in space, time and cause.

sources.quote: IWMT is not panpsychist in that consciousness is restricted to those systems capable of coherently integrated world modeling
According to IWMT, experience would only emerge from systems that have models
